rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for regarding someone with contempt or scorn.

example.english: I really despise people who bully others by relying on their power.
example.traditional: 我真係睇唔起嗰啲恃勢凌人嘅人。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 tai2 m4 hei2 go2 di1 ci5 sai3 ling4 jan4 ge3 jan4

rows.note: Use this formal or written verb for the same contemptuous attitude, especially in serious writing or speech.

example.traditional: 社會應該鄙視學術抄襲。
example.jyutping: se5 wui6 jing1 goi1 pei2 si6 hok6 seot6 caau1 zaap6
